title: Medical Kits
description: This basic mod adds medical kits, when you right click while holding the medical kit, it heals you and gives some effects.
body:
This mod adds basic **medical kits.** When you use the medical kit _(Right click)_ it heals you to max health, and gives you some effects like Enchanted Golden Apples do. I tried to make them not too op, but still worth it to craft. If you are wondering how to craft it, you can craft it like this:

  
  ![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a9febed4bb47d199b41acc2fa52216cfdf1ae0e.png)

#   How to install the mod _(Prism launcher)_.
1. Install Prism Launcher.
2. Create an instance. **(Right click > Create Instance)**
3. Under "Mod Loader" select "NeoForge".
4. Select the version 1.21.8
5. Click "Ok"
6. Right click on the instance, then click edit.
7. Then click "Mods"
8. Now click "Download Mods"
9. Search "Medical Kits" _(Should be 1st or 2nd result)_
10. Click on the mod.
11. Click "Select mod for download"
12. Then click "Review and confirm"
13. Finaly, click launch.
14. Thats it!

PS: _This is my first mod, so it might be really bad, but, idk I hope you enjoy it :)_
